name: DUNA
summary:
What if your room could turn into sand?

DUNA turns your real room into a stage for more than 500 sand art shows, each with its own song. Press play and sand rains onto your floor. The Light Box on your table dances to the music in real cymatics patterns, while a sand floor ripples with the beat. A sand artist draws the story live across your wall.

Catch the magic. A sand creature flies out of the picture: close both hands to keep it as Glass. It comes back as the hero of the ending, your wall breaks open,
